function.name: checkCalendar
function.description: Returns the next 2 open times on the IntakeOps Google Calendar. Use it when the caller wants to book a strategy call.

service_type.description: What is being booked. For IntakeOps sales calls always use 'intakeops-strategy-call'.

requested_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date string (YYYY-MM-DD) if the caller requested a specific date. Omit to return the next available slots.

duration_minutes.description: Length of the call in minutes. Leave out to use the default (30).
